conviction_note: The findings net to about zero (+0.10). TCS's beat, HCLTech's raised guide and Accenture's guide above estimates are positives for the sector. Against them, Wipro has guided below the street at each of its last two prints, and the ADR is up 7.2% in the five days into this one. p_up is 47 because the run-up and that guide history slightly outweigh a short base that grew 60% and could cover. abs_move is 3.5 because no option chain was usable and the rebuilt ADR history is thin: -0.28% on the Q1 FY27 day, and -2.2% pre-open to about -3% on Q4 FY26.
bar: Q2 FY27 IT services revenue about -0.5% to -1.4% QoQ cc (Jefferies -1.4, JM -0.5, MOSL -0.5, Nuvama -1.0) and about -1% in USD, roughly $2.59bn (Emkay, which includes Mindsprint and AlphaNet). EBIT margin up 20-50bp to about 16.4% (MOSL). The street expects a Q3 guide of -2% to 0% cc (Emkay, Nuvama) or -1.5% to +0.5% organic (Jefferies). The company's own Q2 guide is $2,574-2,627m, -1.5% to +0.5% cc. Sources: https://www.kotakneo.com/news/stocks/wipro-q2-fy27-results-preview/ (2026-10-14) and https://www.tradingview.com/news/moodys:ab25a0f6a0c64:0-wipro-q2-preview-brokerages-expect-weak-revenue-growth-margin-recovery/ (undated, the same broker set, and the two agree).
positioning_check: WIT ADR shares short: 102,750,718 at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 14.18 days to cover. That is up from 63,852,960 (7.53 days) on 2026-07-31 and 84,539,063 on 2026-08-31 (https://equibles.com/stocks/wit/shortinterest). This is about 1.0% of shares outstanding. The share of ADS float could not be computed because the ADS count was not obtained. Part of the short is probably ADR-versus-local arbitrage, which weakens the squeeze mechanism. No skew: the option chain is unusable (ATM legs not two-sided). The put/call open interest ratio is 3.42, but on only 615 contracts in total, so it says nothing. Run-up: +7.19% over 5 days and +6.55% over 20 days. The stock is 41.5% below its 52-week high.

findings.finding: Peers that printed after Wipro last spoke are positive. TCS Q2 FY27 revenue was +0.5% QoQ cc with BFSI +2.5% cc, and its stock rose 5.5% on 2026-10-09. HCLTech on 2026-10-12 raised its FY27 cc guide to 2.5-4.0% from 1-4%. Accenture on 2026-10-01 guided FY27 to 3-6% local-currency growth, above estimates. That raises the odds that Wipro's Q3 guide and BFSI commentary land at the upper end of the -2%/0% to -1.5%/+0.5% range the street expects.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide-driven reactions have been negative: Q4 FY26 (2026-04-16) guide of -2% to 0%, called weaker than expected, ADR -2.2% pre-open and about -3% later; Q1 FY27 (2026-07-16) guide below the expected -1%/+1%, ADR -0.28% that day and NSE about -2% the next morning.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The ADR is up 7.2% in five days, and NSE went from Rs159.58 on 2026-10-01 to Rs170.35 on 2026-10-14. What remains is that the brokers' Q3 guide expectations (-2% to 0%) were not raised after HCLTech lifted its own. If the read-through were fully priced, the previews would carry a higher guide expectation, and they do not.
findings.independence: Three separate companies. HCLTech guide raise: https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/hcltech-net-profit-rises-21-to-5132-crore-in-q2-fy27-revenue-up-115. Accenture FY27 guide: https://newsroom.accenture.com/content/4q-full-fy26-earnings/accenture-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-fiscal-2026-results.pdf. It is a peer proxy, not a Wipro number.

findings.finding: Wipro's guide has come in below the street's expected range at both recent prints. Q4 FY26 guided -2% to 0%, called weaker than expected. Q1 FY27 guided -1.5% to +0.5% against an expected -1% to +1%. Q3 (Oct-Dec) carries the furlough season, and Emkay and Nuvama already expect -2% to 0%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY26: ADR -2.2% pre-open and about -3% after the weak guide (https://www.businesstoday.in/amp/markets/stocks/story/wipro-adr-slips-over-2-after-q4-fy26-results-whats-driving-the-move-526034-2026-04-16). Q1 FY27: ADR -0.28% on the day and NSE about -2% the next morning.
findings.source_date: 2026-07-17 (inferred: the article carries the Q1 FY27 figures, Rs24,480cr, and the -1.5%/+0.5% guide; the page shows no date)
findings.why_not_priced: A 7.2% run-up into the print is not what a market expecting a third straight guide disappointment would show. The run-up is the peer rally being applied to Wipro.
findings.independence: Q4 FY26 instance from a separate source: https://www.outlookbusiness.com/amp/story/markets/wipro-shares-slip-4-after-q4-brokerages-flag-concerns-despite-buyback. This is the company's own pattern, not a proxy, but it is a tendency, not a number for this quarter.

findings.finding: The Q2 guide assumed USD/INR 94.50. The rupee traded around 96.0-96.2 in late September, the weakest in nine weeks. That supports the expected 20-50bp margin recovery.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin has not been the deciding line: Q1 FY27's margin fell 130bp to a 15-quarter low, and the ADR moved only -0.28% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Every preview already cites currency tailwinds in its +40bp margin estimate. Left over is the chance of an upside margin print.
findings.independence: Guide FX assumption is in Wipro's own Q1 release: https://www.01net.it/wipro-announces-results-for-the-quarter-ended-june-30-2026/

findings.finding: The US Department of Labor suspended Wipro, with seven other employers, from the PERM labour-certification programme from 2026-10-08, with no end date. Wipro had 523 PERM approvals in FY2025. It is likely to come up on the 10-15 call, where it adds US-onsite delivery-cost questions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None found for this name. The stock rose after the 10-08 announcement, along with the sector.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (page date not read; suspension effective 2026-10-08 per the article)
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is public and the stock rose after it, so it is mostly priced. What remains is whether management quantifies a cost on the call.

findings.finding: Short interest in the ADR rose about 61% into the print, from 63.9m shares (7.5 days to cover) on 2026-07-31 to 102.8m (14.2 days) on 2026-09-30. An in-line or better print can force covering in an ADR that trades about 7-8.5m shares a day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior squeeze on a WIT print found.
findings.why_not_priced: Part of the +7.2% five-day run-up may already be covering, so this is partly priced. Part of the short is probably ADR/local arbitrage, which does not squeeze. That limits the size.
findings.independence: Benzinga reports 85.7m shares short and 6.79 days to cover at the May 2026 settlement (https://it.benzinga.com/quote/WIT/short-interest). Same FINRA data.

findings.finding: Wipro's 2026-09-30 filing pushed the AlphaNet contract acquisition (about $37.3m of annual revenue in CY2025) to close by 2026-12-31 rather than 2026-09-30. Emkay's -1% USD Q2 estimate includes AlphaNet, so that estimate carries roughly $9m (0.35%) of revenue the quarter cannot contain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue misses of this size have not moved the ADR much. Q1 FY27 missed by about 1.2% on rupee revenue and the ADR moved -0.28%.
findings.why_not_priced: One broker's model appears not to reflect the delay. If it were priced, Emkay's preview would exclude AlphaNet.
findings.independence: Revenue figures for the contracts: https://www.outlookbusiness.com/corporate/wipro-to-acquire-select-customer-contracts-of-alpha-net-consulting-for-up-to-708-mn. Emkay's inclusion: https://www.kotakneo.com/news/stocks/wipro-q2-fy27-results-preview/

findings.finding: A revised bench policy took effect on 2026-10-01: Band 2 and below can be separated after 180 days on the bench, and Band 3 and above after 45 days. This is a cost lever for Q3 margin commentary.
findings.why_not_priced: The previews mention 'cost measures' only in general terms. This is small and largely priced.

outside_window.finding: AlphaNet contract acquisition (about $37m of annual revenue) now closes on or before 2026-12-31. Its inorganic contribution lands in Q3/Q4 FY27, not inside this window.
Infosys reports Q2 FY27 on 2026-10-23. Its sector read-through falls after the exit window.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The +7.2% five-day run-up already holds the peer read-through, so the positive peer evidence agrees with the run-up and is largely priced. The guide-disappointment pattern cuts against it.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the peer read-through goes from +0.8 to +0.6, because Wipro's guide-line reactions over two prints were -0.3% and about -2.5% even when the sector was firm.
Lesson 7 (positioning): shorts rose 61% to 14.2 days to cover, so the largest negative, the guide-disappointment pattern, goes from -1.0 to -0.8.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the AlphaNet item is a single-broker bar issue (Emkay only), so it goes from -0.2 to -0.1.

Rebuild the reaction history for foreign private issuers: the ADR results-day moves (-0.28% for Q1 FY27; -2.2% pre-open to about -3% for Q4 FY26) replace the baseline's 6-K history, and abs_move_pct goes from 4.0 to 3.5. p_up stays at 47.
